metric_descriptions.completed_tasks: 四轮/八轮全部成功的 Program 数
metric_descriptions.failed_tasks: 至少一轮失败的 Program 数
metric_descriptions.tasks_with_patch: 生成代码补丁的任务数；本实验不适用
metric_descriptions.mean_task_duration_seconds: 成功 Program 的平均完成时间
metric_descriptions.p50_task_duration_seconds: 成功 Program 完成时间 p50
metric_descriptions.p95_task_duration_seconds: 成功 Program 完成时间 p95
metric_descriptions.p99_task_duration_seconds: 成功 Program 完成时间 p99
metric_descriptions.run_wall_time_seconds: 整批从提交到全部结束的用时
metric_descriptions.request_throughput_per_second: 成功请求数 / 整批用时
metric_descriptions.input_token_throughput_per_second: 成功请求输入 tokens / 整批用时
metric_descriptions.output_token_throughput_per_second: 成功请求输出 tokens / 整批用时
metric_descriptions.requests: 已记录的客户端请求数
metric_descriptions.input_tokens: 成功请求 usage 输入 tokens 总数
metric_descriptions.output_tokens: 成功请求 usage 输出 tokens 总数
metric_descriptions.prefix_cache_hit_rate: P native prefix 命中 tokens / 查询 tokens
metric_descriptions.prompt_token_hit_rate: P cached prompt tokens / 客户端 usage 输入 tokens
metric_descriptions.latency_mean_seconds: 成功单次请求端到端耗时均值
metric_descriptions.latency_p50_seconds: 成功单次请求端到端耗时 p50
metric_descriptions.latency_p95_seconds: 成功单次请求端到端耗时 p95
metric_descriptions.latency_p99_seconds: 成功单次请求端到端耗时 p99
metric_descriptions.ttft_mean_seconds: 成功单次请求首个内容输出等待均值
metric_descriptions.ttft_p50_seconds: 成功单次请求首个内容输出等待 p50
metric_descriptions.ttft_p95_seconds: 成功单次请求首个内容输出等待 p95
metric_descriptions.ttft_p99_seconds: 成功单次请求首个内容输出等待 p99
metric_descriptions.vllm_queue_time_mean_seconds: P 与所选 D 的引擎 WAITING 统计均值之和
metric_descriptions.vllm_prefill_time_mean_seconds: P 与所选 D 的引擎 PREFILL 统计均值之和
metric_descriptions.vllm_decode_time_mean_seconds: P 与所选 D 的引擎 DECODE 统计均值之和
metric_descriptions.vllm_inference_time_mean_seconds: P 与所选 D 的引擎 RUNNING 统计均值之和

percentile_method: linear interpolation, position=(n-1)*q; legacy task p95 retained separately
table_aggregation: median of per-run metrics; counts refer to a representative single run, not sums across repeats
engine_phase_aggregation: (P histogram delta sum + D0 delta sum + D1 delta sum) / client successful requests; P count=N, D0+D1 count=N; excludes Router queue
prompt_token_hit_rate_denominator: client successful usage input tokens; P metrics omit one boundary token per request in this deployment
